items: Premium Outdoor Rocking Chair Cushions Set Of 2 – Our 48x20x4 inch patio rocking chair cushion is made of 100% polyester fabric, built for long-lasting outdoor use, waterproof, weatherproof, UV resistant, and fade proof for all-season performance on your porch, deck, or patio furniture.

Thick Comfort & Support – 4-inch thick padded outdoor rocking chair cushion delivers soft yet firm support for long sitting hours, designed for adult-sized rocking chairs, oversized 48-inch long and 20-inch wide for full coverage and comfortable relaxation outdoors.

100% Polyester Outdoor Fabric – Durable, breathable, stain-resistant, and washable polyester material withstands sun, rain, and daily outdoor use, heavy duty construction maintains shape and color without flattening or fading quickly.

All Weather Outdoor Performance – Waterproof and weatherproof patio rocking chair cushion fits most standard outdoor rocking chairs, ideal for porch, deck, lawn, garden, and patio furniture, easy to clean and maintain for year-round use.

Wide Application for Outdoor Spaces – Perfect as outdoor rocking chair cushion, patio rocking chair pad, porch rocking chair cushion, deck furniture cushion, and outdoor seating pad, adds comfort and decor to your outdoor living area.

items.label: Other Special Features of the Product
items.value: Waterproof, Fade resistance, Durable, Thick, Breathable

items.label: Product Care Instructions
items.value: Recommended lightly spot clean or hand wash outdoor cushion fabric with mild detergent and cool water.Let dry naturally.Do not bleach or remove.
